mappings.name: Disobedient to task specification
mappings.note: F-20 invented a restriction the roster never imposed; F-22 dispatched by line number against its own warning. Spec-deviation, but dispatcher-side.

mappings.name: Disobedient to role specification
mappings.note: F-18/F-19 acted on agent infrastructure / auto-loaded instruction surfaces without approval (role-boundary overreach).

mappings.name: Step repetition
mappings.note: No F-series entry is a within-trace repetition failure (F-04 counts repeated advisory records as a backlog: a measurement error, not step repetition).

mappings.name: Loss of conversation history
mappings.note: F-33(a) lost track of the mains after wrap-up; nearest analogue but fleet-state tracking, not context loss. Verify.

mappings.name: Conversation reset
mappings.note: No F-series entry; intake-1110 dive also lists this as a framework artifact for a dispatch-once fleet.

mappings.name: Failure to ask for clarification
mappings.note: F-30 presented a decision as prose instead of options; adjacent (coordinator-to-operator boundary), not identical.

mappings.name: Task derailment
mappings.note: F-14 shallow dispatch; F-36(a) effort on a non-worthwhile suggestion.

mappings.name: Information withholding
mappings.note: No F-series entry; intake-1110 dive lists as untestable for an isolated-subagent fleet.

mappings.name: Ignored other agent's input
mappings.note: F-34(a) completed main work went unrouted to the auditor. Direction differs (output not routed, rather than input ignored).

mappings.name: Premature termination
mappings.note: No F-series entry cleanly matches; F-10/F-11 ('reported instead of acting') are closer to a stop-too-early pattern but were not confirmed.

mappings.name: No or incomplete verification
mappings.note: Wrong or post-hoc instruments, unverified merge checks, unverified supervisor visibility, self-report taken as an answer. Densest overlap.

mappings.name: Weak verification
mappings.note: A check existed but was scoped or instrumented too weakly (scoped duty-cycle, unanchored checkbox regex, advisory counts, dispatch-as-utilisation).

mappings.name: Incorrect verification
mappings.note: A verification claim that was false as stated (false 'safe fast-forward', false per-agent claim, false reboot premise, withdrawn figure, false hazard).
